propositions: Current clarity_score rewards volume and legacy shape rather than adherence to documented author guidance, allowing padded tickets to pass without required sections
Clarity scoring logic is duplicated across _engine_support/gates.py and llm/plan_review/det_floor.py, creating maintenance drift and inconsistency
Documented plan-writing guidance conflicts with active criteria (Success Criteria vs. Acceptance Criteria collapse; rejected alternative requirement vs. G6 positive-rationale-only)

Deterministic checks can be added for required-section structure (keyed on graph altitude), AC verification coverage, placeholder-free scope, grounded edit-sets, AC text hygiene, and Testing shape without requiring semantic LLM judgment

Current approach-level checks (H2 heading, minimum character count, dash bullets) do not validate that heading content is actually present before the next section or that sections contain substantive material
